items.description: A new and technically advanced rootkit called VoidLink has emerged as a serious threat to Linux systems, blending Loadable Kernel Modules (LKMs) with extended Berkeley Packet Filter (eBPF) programs to hide deep inside the operating system’s core. items.title: CISA Warns of Langflow Code Injection Vulnerability Exploited in Attacks

items.description: A critical local privilege escalation vulnerability has been identified in the IDrive Cloud Backup Client for Windows. items.title: GhostClaw AI Assisted Malware Attacking macOS Users to Deploy Credential-Stealing Payloads
items.description: A new malware campaign called GhostClaw is actively targeting macOS users through fake GitHub repositories and AI-assisted development workflows. The campaign uses social engineering disguised as legitimate developer tools to steal user credentials and drop secondary payloads on infected systems. items.title: LeakBase Hacker Forum Admin Arrested in Russia by Law Enforcement Authorities
items.description: Russian law enforcement has arrested the suspected administrator of LeakBase, a prominent international hacker forum. The operation, coordinated by the Russian Ministry of Internal Affairs (MVD) alongside the Bureau of Special Technical Measures (BSTM), dismantled a platform that traded in stolen personal data and compromised network access for four years. items.title: ZDI-CAN-30207: Telegram
items.description: A CVSS score 9.8 AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H severity vulnerability discovered by 'Michael DePlante (@izobashi) of TrendAI Zero Day Initiative' was reported to the affected vendor on: 2026-03-26, 0 days ago.
